questions.question: Which MITRE ATT&CK technique is most directly associated with Event ID 4657?
A Run key modification detected by Event ID 4657 most closely maps to which technique?
options: T1547.001 - Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
questions.explanation: Run keys are a well-known persistence mechanism.

questions.question: An attacker disables Microsoft Defender through registry changes. Which ATT&CK technique best fits?
options: T1562.001 - Disable or Modify Security Tools

questions.question: Why is T1112 often observed together with other ATT&CK techniques?
options: Registry modification usually enables another objective such as persistence or defense evasion
Registry modification is always the initial access vector
Registry changes only occur after exfiltration
questions.explanation: Registry edits are commonly used to support other attacker goals.

questions.question: PowerShell modifies a Winlogon registry value to launch malware at logon. Which pair best describes the activity?
questions.explanation: PowerShell executes the command and Winlogon/Run-style persistence is established.

questions.question: Why should analysts map detections to MITRE ATT&CK?
options: To standardize detection coverage and threat reporting
questions.explanation: ATT&CK provides a common language for detections.

questions.question: Which mapping is the most accurate for IFEO Debugger abuse?
questions.explanation: IFEO abuse triggers execution through registry-based configuration.

questions.question: A registry modification changes a Windows service configuration for persistence. Which technique is most appropriate?
Which statement best explains why a single 4657 event should not automatically be mapped only to T1112?
options: The registry change may support persistence, defense evasion, or execution depending on the modified key
questions.explanation: The registry path determines the broader ATT&CK context.

questions.question: Which evidence most improves confidence when assigning an ATT&CK technique?
options: Registry path, process context, and correlated events
questions.explanation: Accurate ATT&CK mapping depends on context, not a single field.
